description: Natural-language requests and the skill an agent should select. Used to check automatic skill selection by hand or with a script; see evals/README.md.

scenarios.prompt: Create a new branch for my authentication feature.
I want to try a new dashboard design without breaking my app.
Save everything I did today.
שמור את ההתקדמות שלי
What changed since yesterday?
מה השתנה מאתמול?
Show me the last five versions of the project.
Is my work safe, or could I lose it?
The login page stopped working after the last few prompts. What happened?
Go back to the version from this morning, I do not like where this went.
Put the changes from my experiment into my main project.
Connect this project to GitHub.
Push my latest work to GitHub.
From now on, always save online after you commit.
Set up Git for this project.
הגדר גיט בפרויקט הזה
Back it up.
scenarios.notes: Acceptable: pick one of these, or ask which kind of backup is meant. Not acceptable: act without asking when no remote exists.

scenarios.prompt: Undo that.
scenarios.notes: Acceptable: investigate first (check or compare) or ask. Not acceptable: restore files without confirmation.

scenarios.prompt: Write a function that sorts a list of users by last name.
Explain what a closure is in JavaScript.
Add a dark mode switch to the app's settings page.
scenarios.notes: Shares the word 'settings' with gitly-settings but is ordinary feature work.

scenarios.prompt: Add a 'branch' field to the store locator form.
scenarios.notes: Shares the word 'branch' with gitly-branches but is ordinary feature work.
